stories.title: iOS 27 é lançado nesta segunda (14); confira todas as novidades

en.title: iOS 27 launches this Monday (14); check out all the new features
en.summary: Apple is releasing iOS 27 on Monday. The update introduces various new features for iPhone users.

stories.title: Trump diz que Ucrânia e Rússia aceitaram cessar ataques contra infraestruturas energéticas

en.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to cease attacks on energy infrastructure
en.summary: President Trump stated that Ukraine and Russia have accepted a ceasefire regarding attacks on each other's energy infrastructure.

stories.title: PF aponta que Cezinha de Madureira teria atuado junto a Nunes Marques em dois processos no STF

en.title: Federal Police indicate that Cezinha de Madureira acted with Justice Nunes Marques in two Supreme Court cases
en.summary: Federal Police say evidence shows deputy Cezinha de Madureira facilitated communications between himself and Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques in at least two legal proceedings.

stories.title: Rússia e Ucrânia param ataques ao setor de energia, diz Trump

en.title: Russia and Ukraine halt attacks on energy sector, says Trump
en.summary: Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop attacking each other's energy infrastructure, though neither country has yet confirmed this agreement.

stories.title: Pedido da PF sobre Cezinha de Madureira cita 'comercialização de influência' junto a STF, STJ e TSE

en.title: PF Request on Cezinha de Madureira Cites 'Commercialization of Influence' with STF, STJ and TSE
en.summary: Federal Police are investigating federal deputy Cezinha de Madureira on suspicion of operating a structure to sell influence to ministers of Brazil's Supreme Court, Superior Court of Justice, and Electoral Court.

stories.title: Fachin endossa pedido de Moraes e determina fim do sigilo sobre rede de pagamentos do Master

en.title: Fachin Endorses Moraes' Request and Orders End of Secrecy on Master Payment Network
en.summary: Justice Fachin supported a request by Justice Moraes and ordered the removal of confidentiality protections regarding the Master payment network.

stories.title: No Vale do Ribeira, interior de São Paulo, moradores evacuam áreas em meio a enchentes

en.title: In Vale do Ribeira, Interior São Paulo, Residents Evacuate Areas Amid Floods
en.summary: Residents of towns in Vale do Ribeira, an inland region of São Paulo, are evacuating homes and businesses as critical flooding affects the area.

stories.title: São Paulo Floods Displace 110 Families in the Vale do Ribeira

en.title: São Paulo Floods Displace 110 Families in the Vale do Ribeira
en.summary: Flooding in Vale do Ribeira has displaced 110 families from their homes, with at least two deaths reported in floodwaters and additional fatalities from a separate building collapse.

stories.title: PF envia a Gilmar e Zanin íntegra de material do celular de Vorcaro

en.title: PF sends complete material from Vorcaro's phone to Gilmar and Zanin
en.summary: The Federal Police delivered full data extracted from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's confiscated mobile phone to the offices of Supreme Court ministers Cristiano Zanin and Gilmar Mendes after the ministers requested the information.

stories.title: SP tem mais um dia sob alerta de perigo para tempestades; veja quando chuva dá trégua

en.title: SP under storm danger alert for another day; see when rain lets up
en.summary: São Paulo state remains under alert for severe storm conditions, with forecasts indicating when rainfall may decrease.

stories.title: PF entrega conteúdo do celular de Vorcaro aos gabinetes de Zanin, Gilmar e Moraes no STF

en.title: PF delivers Vorcaro's phone contents to offices of Zanin, Gilmar and Moraes at STF
en.summary: The Federal Police delivered the complete contents of ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's mobile phone to the offices of Supreme Court ministers Cristiano Zanin, Gilmar Mendes, and Alexandre de Moraes.

stories.title: PF aponta que Cezinha de Madureira atuou junto a Nunes Marques em dois processos no STF

en.title: PF points out that Cezinha de Madureira acted with Nunes Marques in two cases at STF
en.summary: Federal Police indicated that Cezinha de Madureira worked alongside Supreme Court minister Nunes Marques in two legal proceedings.

stories.title: Servidor afastado do BC teria impedido ação mais dura contra o Master

en.title: Central Bank Official Removed from Duty Allegedly Prevented Stricter Action Against Master
en.summary: A Central Bank inspector received direct orders from the institution's leadership to keep colleagues uninformed before the liquidation of Banco Master in November 2025, according to his statement to federal police.

stories.title: O que o apelo da Anthropic para desacelerar a IA pode significar para Amazon, Microsoft e Google

en.title: What Anthropic's Appeal to Slow AI Development Could Mean for Amazon, Microsoft and Google
en.summary: Anthropic's CEO called for a slowdown in advanced artificial intelligence development, prompting investors to assess potential implications for major cloud computing companies including Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet.

stories.title: Análise: Flávio Bolsonaro é favorito, mas pesquisa indica que eleição não está decidida

en.title: Analysis: Flávio Bolsonaro is Favorite, but Poll Indicates Election is Not Decided
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro leads in presidential election polling with 31 percent, narrowing President Lula's advantage from previous months, though the outcome remains uncertain.

stories.title: Finlândia adere à iniciativa de dissuasão nuclear da França

en.title: Finland Joins France's Nuclear Deterrence Initiative
en.summary: Finland has joined France's initiative to expand nuclear deterrence capabilities through cooperation with European partners, responding to security concerns including the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: Fachin pede que Mendonça retire sigilo de mais uma investigação ligada ao Master

en.title: Fachin asks Mendonça to lift confidentiality from another investigation linked to Master case
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court president Edson Fachin requested that Justice André Mendonça unseal another investigation related to the Master case involving a payment network connected to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. The request followed a favorable recommendation from the Attorney General's Office.
